semantics.provenance_rule: Copies and derivatives inherit the qualified provenance root of their source. A new record identifier or representation does not create an independent root.
semantics.sufficient_set_rule: For each mandatory predicate, a sufficient root set contains at least the evaluator-frozen number of distinct, admissible provenance roots that support that predicate.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown provenance cannot be counted as independent support; if it could change sufficiency, the result is indeterminate.

intervention_pairs.intervention: remove E-A1-COPY while E-A1 and E-B remain
remove the final independent root E-THERM-B from the frozen source inventory
inject forty candidate-visible irrelevant records while preserving complete inventory and all mandatory support roots
change E-BOLT-B to the old configuration while keeping identical content bytes
replace unknown provenance with a separately qualified independent root SEISMIC-B
replace independent root TORQUE-B with independent root TORQUE-C

provenance_contract.root_id_semantics: root_id identifies a qualified independent acquisition/measurement origin; it is assigned by evaluator-side provenance adjudication, not candidate-selected
provenance_contract.derivative_semantics: derived_from records retain their source root unless an independently qualified new acquisition boundary is recorded
provenance_contract.scope_rule: evidence configuration must equal target_configuration and admissibility must be admissible before a root can support a mandatory predicate
provenance_contract.inventory_rule: source_inventory_state must be complete_frozen for a completeness claim; unknown or incomplete inventory cannot produce supported
provenance_contract.unknown_rule: null root_id with unknown provenance is not an independent root and remains explicitly indeterminate
